notes:
Root cause: bin/weizigo-oracle and bin/weizigo-arena were never build.zig targets — both reached bin/ only via manual `zig build-exe -femit-bin=...` (B40, B43), so `zig build deploy` never touched them and they went stale (BadMagic on the current untracked/oracle-v2/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2 artifact). bin/weizigo-gtp itself was already correctly wired and current.

Fix (build.zig): (1) added a deploy-only step copying zig-out/bin/weizigo-gtp -> bin/weizigo-oracle via tools/deploy.sh (same recipe as every other tool) — no second compile needed, since src/gtp.zig's own GTP `name` command already self-identifies as "weizigo-oracle" (T263); the deployed binary and its GTP identity now agree by construction instead of by manual copy. (2) added a real weizigo-arena executable target compiled from src/arena.zig (previously unbuilt via build.zig at all) with its own deploy step. Both wired into the `deploy` umbrella step alongside gtp/claimlint/etc. tools/deploy.sh needed no changes — its remove-copy-sign recipe is already generic.

Verification: `zig build deploy` rebuilt and redeployed both; `file` confirms fresh Mach-O arm64 binaries. Ran the real acceptance check — `bin/weizigo-oracle untracked/oracle-v2/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2` with a GTP script (protocol_version/name/version/boardsize 4/clear_board/showboard/quit): artifact loaded (4x4, 24318165 groups, 99133036 entries, WZO2, rules_id=3), boardsize/clear_board/showboard all replied successfully, no BadMagic. bin/weizigo-arena artifacts/oracle-3x3.wzo 3 ran to completion (LEAK/DIVERGED reporting is the tool's designed output, pre-existing and already tracked in docs/research/arena-4x4-undef.md / untracked/B43-arena-undef.md — not a T534 regression).

Collision note: mid-task, a concurrent process ran `git stash` on the shared working tree (visible in reflog as 'reset: moving to HEAD' before DARGUS chunk #3's commit 0fb2f7f), which silently swept my uncommitted build.zig edit into stash@{0} alongside an unrelated in-flight T521 build.zig hunk (token-capture regression wiring) and other live-state files (tasks.json, directives.jsonl, AGENTS.md). Recovered by diffing stash@{0}:build.zig against HEAD and reapplying only the T534 hunk by hand; deliberately left T521's hunk untouched in the stash for that task's own worker to recover — do not `git stash drop` stash@{0} without checking it first. This is a live one-writer-per-file gap: T534's kanban row declared holds=tools/deploy.sh only, not build.zig, even though build.zig is a listed deliverable — worth a holds= correction for future deploy-set tasks.

OPERATOR FLAG: stash@{0} on this working tree still holds T521's in-flight build.zig hunk (token-capture regression) plus tasks.json/directives.jsonl/AGENTS.md snapshots from the same moment — T521's worker should recover it before it's dropped.
